meaning: Two good friends — friendship, fellowship and comradeship
note: From “Adwen yedwen no baanu”: thinking is done in pairs. And “Hu m’ani so ma me nti na atwe mmienu nam”: it is because of “blow the dust from my eyes” that two deer walk together.
references: Arthur, G. F. Kojo. Cloth as Metaphor: (Re)reading the Adinkra Cloth Symbols of the Akan of Ghana (2001)
